rig.gpuString: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (0x0000220A) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

method: Built editor (npm run build) served from dist/ on 127.0.0.1; Playwright-driven headless Edge. Open time: 5 cold opens (a blank map between opens releases all templates). Frames: 22 synchronous scene.draw() calls each followed by a 1-pixel readPixels to complete GPU work; first 2 discarded. Draw calls from renderer.info with autoReset=false (all passes of the frame), shadow pass isolated by wrapping renderer.shadowMap.render.
